about: What We Do's film, for scripts/build-service-film.py (its docstring explains the pieces). The four anchors are A1-A4; H1_v1 is the one hold 1 take whose last frame the morph and H2 start from.

segments.name: hold 1: Development, pushing in over the pattern table (a big move, so more frames)
morph 1>2: a machine comes down and the paper sews into cloth; then through the needle
hold 2: Manufacturing, the needle running the seam (after the clip's own dissolve in)
morph 2>3: the needle runs on, then the seam becomes the finished coat
hold 3: Quality control, the coat under the lamp
morph 3>4: packed into the carton, out the loading door to the port
hold 4: Logistics, the port at sunset
